description: This file implements the Login page component for the front-end of a web application. It manages user input for email, organization selection (via fetched organization list or manual input), password, and handles the login flow, including fetching user organizations and submitting login credentials. It also contains styling and UI logic specific to the login process.

methods.name: handleFetchOrgs
methods.description: Handles the fetch of user organizations based on email input, manages loading state, error handling, and updates UI step to 'credentials'.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Performs login request using email, organization ID (encrypted), and password; handles success/failure states and stores auth token.
